curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the roaming visual search, then far and side scanning, then speed management and unposted limits, then night and storm caps
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on scanning habits, limits and speed caps
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on scan distances, default limits and the storm speed cap

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach braking before curves, then slick-road handling and brake technique, then hydroplaning, then the parts of stopping distance
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on curves, slick roads, hydroplaning and stopping distance
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on brake technique, hydroplaning and stopping distance parts

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the space cushion, then the four-second gap and when to stretch it, then side room, blind spots and tailgaters
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on the four-second count, stretched gaps and side room
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on gap counting, when to stretch and handling tailgaters

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach careful backing and the missed-exit rule, then headlights, horn use, and signaling every move
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on backing, headlights, horn and signals
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on missed exits, headlight hours, horn taps and signal rules
